title: Only the responsible person marks a lead lost — with a reason AND remarks

steps.do: Sign in as Test BDM (not responsible for it) and open the lead → Actions tab.
steps.expect: Under "It did not happen": "Only the person responsible for this lead — Test MktExec — marks it lost." No Lost button.
steps.observed: Under "It did not happen": "Only the person responsible for this lead — Test MktExec — marks it lost." No Lost button.

steps.do: Sign in as Test MktExec → Actions tab → "It did not happen". Leave "Why it was lost" on "choose a reason…", type remarks → press "Lost".
steps.expect: The browser asks you to choose a reason; nothing changes.
steps.observed: Pressed "Not pursued": the browser asks "Please select an item in the list." on "Why it was lost"; nothing changed.
steps.note: The button is labelled "Not pursued" (the pipeline's lost stage), not "Lost".

steps.do: Choose "Price too high / lost on price", leave "Remarks — what happened" empty → "Lost".
steps.expect: The browser asks for the remarks; nothing changes.
steps.observed: The browser asks "Please fill out this field." on the remarks; nothing changed.

steps.expect: The lead shows "Closed — this one did not happen." with your reason and remarks.
steps.observed: The lead shows "Closed — this one did not happen." with "Price too high / lost on price" and "Competitor 20% cheaper".

steps.do: Lead register → List → tick two open leads of Test MktExec → "Mark lost" → choose a reason, leave "Remarks — required" empty → apply.
steps.expect: Refused: "Add your remarks — what happened, in a sentence. Both the reason and the remarks are required." Nothing is marked lost.
steps.observed: Refused: "Add your remarks — what happened, in a sentence. Both the reason and the remarks are required." Nothing marked lost.

steps.do: Same, with remarks "No budget this year".
steps.expect: Both are marked lost. A lead belonging to someone else in the same tick-list is left alone "(…not yours to mark lost)".
steps.observed: "2 leads updated. 1 left alone (already closed, or not yours to mark lost)."

steps.do: Left menu → Insights → Sales dashboard → "Why we lose".
steps.observed: "Why we lose" reads: Why we lose Loss reasons REASON DEALS LEADS VALUE Client budget withdrawn / on hold 0 2 ₹2,00,000 Price too high / lost on price 0 1 ₹1,00,000 Won 0 (₹0) against lost 0 in this window.
